briefdescription.para: This pass optimizes atomic operations by using a single lane of a wavefront to perform the atomic operation, thus reducing contention on that memory location.

detaileddescription.para:
Atomic optimizer uses following strategies to compute scan and reduced values
DPP - This is the most efficient implementation for scan. DPP uses Whole Wave Mode (WWM)
